statement: USB 0x02 has a 47-byte common output body with valid_flag0/1 bytes: motor/rumble-select bits, speaker/mic volume and audio routing enables; valid_flag1 governs mute LED/power-save/lightbar/player indicator, while a later flag byte controls LED setup and improved rumble. Two trigger-effect blocks (right then left) are 11 bytes each; sound/LED/rumble fields are separately gated.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b/829a65d, HHD adbd50f and community pinned commits; physical firmware unknown
